iut_type: End Product incorporating Q309899 Core-Controller SoC (Move company)
customer_question: By when do we need to obtain the receipt number (for the SIG registration fee payment)?
question_variants: What is the deadline for getting the wire transfer receipt number before registration?
When must the $11,040 SIG fee payment be completed relative to registration confirmation?
actual_issue: Move company asked when they needed to have the receipt number for their SIG fee wire transfer in hand, relative to the registration confirmation step.
plain_english_explanation: The $11,040 USD wire transfer to Bluetooth SIG must be completed through the partner bank by the day before the registration confirmation (Submission) is executed.
consultant_answer: Please complete the $11,040 USD wire transfer through the partner bank by the day before the registration confirmation operation is performed. Refer to the attached procedure document for details.
decision_logic: SIG requires payment to clear and a receipt number to be available before final registration confirmation can be executed, so the payment must be initiated with enough lead time to complete before the planned Submission date.
final_recommendation: Always provide customers a clear payment-lead-time instruction (e.g., 'complete wire transfer by the day before planned Submission') rather than a vague timeframe, to avoid registration-day delays.
risk_if_done_wrong: If the wire transfer and receipt number aren't ready before the planned Submission date, registration confirmation will be blocked, delaying the entire project.
